meta.name: git-master
meta.description: MUST USE for ANY git operations. Atomic commits, rebase/squash, history search (blame, bisect, log -S). STRONGLY RECOMMENDED: Use with task(category='quick', load_skills=['git-master'], ...) to save context. Triggers: 'commit', 'rebase', 'squash', 'who wrote', 'when was X added', 'find the commit that'.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 执行 git 提交、整理提交记录与搜索历史
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果管理代码提交、整理提交记录或追溯历史修改是你的日常。
copy.tagline_en: Commit code, organize commit history, and search past changes
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you often commit code, organize commit history, or search past changes.

howto.what: 装上后它接管所有 git 操作:把改动拆成多个原子提交、整理(squash/rebase)提交历史,并用 blame、bisect、log -S 查找某次改动是何时何处引入的。
howto.when: 当你提出提交代码、rebase/squash、查找改动来源等请求时触发;原文要求任何 git 操作都必须先经它。它先判断是提交、改写还是查历史模式。

say.text: 帮我把这些改动拆成原子提交
say.note: 先检测仓库提交风格,再输出提交计划

say.text: 把这个分支的多个提交 squash 整理一下
say.note: 进入 rebase 模式改写本地历史

say.text: 这段代码是谁写的、什么时候加的
say.note: 用 blame / log -S 查历史

howto.what_en: Once installed it handles all git operations: splitting changes into atomic commits, cleaning up commit history via rebase/squash, and finding when or where a change was introduced via blame, bisect, or log -S.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you ask to commit code, rebase/squash, or trace a change's origin; the original requires it for any git operation. It first picks commit, rewrite, or history-search mode.

say_en.text: Split my changes into atomic commits
say_en.note: Detects repo commit style, prints a commit plan

say_en.text: Squash the commits on this branch
say_en.note: Enters rebase mode to rewrite local history

say_en.text: Who wrote this code and when was it added
